_meta.datasheet_section: Package Types p1 + Table 3-1 p9 + MC package drawing C04-123C p25 + land pattern C04-2123B p26
_meta.package: 8-lead DFN 2x3x0.9 mm (MC), 0.5 mm pitch, EP = pin 9
_meta.notes: D = PWM only, input-to-output bypass. Blank packaging = tube; DT = tape and reel. Same die and package.

pins.name: SW
pins.note: Inductor from VIN; up to 800 mA peak

pins.name: VOUTS
pins.note: Output sense; connect externally to VOUTP

pins.name: VIN
pins.note: 0.65 V typ / 0.8 V max start-up; >=4.7 uF

pins.name: EP
pins.note: No internal connection; must be connected to VSS (same potential as SGND/PGND)
